description: DATED dividend record per ticker. Each event stores the dividend as a dimensionless YIELD FRACTION measured at its own ex-date (y = amount / close on that date), with both figures taken from Yahoo's split-adjusted series so the ratio is correct at any point in history. A trailing-twelve-month yield is the SUM of y over ex-dates in (t-365d, t]. Being scale-free, y composes with a Bloomberg-derived upside without mixing the two price conventions (Bloomberg quotes the contemporaneous traded price; Yahoo back-adjusts for splits). Read via data/dividends.js — do not hand-edit.
source: Yahoo Finance v3 chart(events: "div"), split-adjusted amounts and closes
